title: Figure 64: electric field contour around dielectric-coated metallic sphere at 300 MHz
description: ANSYS nodal-solution contour plot of electric field in V/m for the half-symmetry 10 m metallic sphere with 1 m dielectric coating at 300 MHz (25 elements per wavelength). Colorful banded field pattern inside and around the circular sphere cross-section, scale 0 to 1.156 V/m. From the BAASS radar cross-section electromagnetic modeling.
